text:
Ana: Quick sync — SI partner is asking for an auditor witness window and a signed chain-of-custody for artifacts before we go live. who owns this?
Samir: I can take the witness scheduling. need to confirm dates with the partner. any artifact list from security yet?
Lisa: Security asked for SOC2 report, the last pen summary, and the uploads (redacted) for the next 90 days. also they want presigned links rather than full access.
Nina: FYI legal requires an embargo on any external announcement until the attestation is uploaded and validated by security. recommend we gate comms.
security-bot: Reminder: upload hashes + signed manifest required for 3rd party viewing. See https://redwood.internal/compliance/witnessing for format.
Samir: timeline options: next Tue/Wed morning PT for witness (partner travel), or remote on Thu. which gives security time to scrub artifacts?
Lisa: Tue morning is tight. If we do Thu remote, security can run redaction + a brief re-scan by Wed EOD. Thu witness then sign-off Fri.
Ana: OK Thu remote works. Samir please confirm with partner. can you also draft the artifact checklist we'll hand them?
Samir: Drafted a checklist — pulling it into the channel. short version: SOC2 summary (pdf), pen test executive summary (redacted), vuln-scan CSV (zips per host), config snapshot (anonymized), signed manifest.
Partner Ops: We need presigned links for the zips (7 day expiry) and a one-time access token for the witness session. can you provide S3 presign command?
Samir: example presign:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/si-pack-2024.zip --expires-in 604800
```
also create folder with read-only perms and enable object lock until 7 days past witness.
Lisa: Security will produce a short attestation note after the witness. legal approves embargo until attestation is posted. cc: @Nina for legal sign-off.
Nina: I approve gating the public blog/announce and partner co-marketing until the attestation is finalized. internal comms (sales ops) can be prepped but not published.
Ana: Who will be on the witness call from our side? suggested: Samir (partner ops), Lisa (security), Ana (product) + partner rep.
Samir: confirmed with partner — Thu 2024-05-23 10:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite and include dial-in + recording consent.
Lisa: I'll run the artifact scrub Wed morning (start 09:00 PT). if anything sensitive remains I'll flag it here immediately.
security-bot: Scheduled scan job: compliance-scan-171750 for 2024-05-22T16:00:00Z. report posted to /compliance/artifacts/171750-scan.log (redacted).
Ana: Great. last ask — who owns the announcement draft so it can be frozen until sign-off? I can own the draft but need someone to hold publishing.
Nina: Legal will hold publishing rights. please add legal-ops@redwood to the doc permissions.
Partner Ops: We'll prepare a short partner-facing one-pager for the witness. send to me and I'll attach to the invite.
Samir: putting checklist + presign link plan into the shared drive now. will post final links in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Ana: Perfect. thanks everyone. I'll queue the announce draft as "draft — embargoed" and tag when security attestation is live.
Samir: posted presigns: s3://redwood-compliance/si-pack-171750.zip (presigned, 7d). link posted to private drive.
Lisa: scrub complete — small PII fragment removed, resubmitted. security attestation pending witness.
Ana: closing loop — witness invite sent, legal gate in place, security scrubbed. will update thread after sign-off.
Partner Ops: thanks team — partner notified and prepped for Thu.
security-bot: Attestation checklist: witness_completed, manifest_signed, scans_passed. current status: witness_scheduled, manifest_pending, scans_passed.
Ana: Noted. follow-up after witness.
